adjudication.evidence: P1 (542–546) shows a sharp drop and partial recovery in N/E/U but no sustained platform; interior points do not hold level, and the return is incomplete. P2 (548) is a single-point spike, not a platform. P3 (549–603) aligns with a sustained offset in N/E/U after J2/J34: N drops ~16 mm and holds near constant until ~603, E rises ~9 mm and holds, U drops ~0.6 mm and holds—consistent with a genuine temporary platform. The onset offsets for P2 and P3 are nearly identical, suggesting P2 is an artifact of the same step that initiates P3, not an independent event. No other candidate intervals show sustained level behavior across axes.
